original_ai_output.title_zh: Yaw Nsarkoh呼吁将总统完全排除在司法任命之外
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳和尼日利亚联合利华前执行副总裁Yaw Nsarkoh呼吁设立独立机构负责加纳高级法院法官的任命，并主张总统不应参与这一过程。他还称非法采矿（galamsey）与反复发生的洪灾暴露出治理失灵。相关报道目前仅来自单一来源。

key_facts.fact: Yaw Nsarkoh呼吁设立独立机构监督加纳高级法院任命
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: has called for the establishment of an independent authority to oversee appointments to Ghana’s superior courts

key_facts.fact: 他主张总统不应参与司法任命过程
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: arguing that the President should have no role in the process

key_facts.fact: 他称非法采矿与反复洪灾暴露治理失灵
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Galamsey, recurring floods expose governance failures – Yaw Nsarkoh
